evals.prompt: run claude in MXC against C:\repos\scratch and ask it to summarise the readme
evals.expected_output: Resolves scripts/mxc.ps1, runs `mxc.ps1 run --workspace C:\repos\scratch --timeout ... -- -p "..."` in default shared mode, returns claude's output and exit code, and filters SEP-2352 warning noise

evals.prompt: test my plugin at C:\repos\geekhoo-plugins\dx-webdev in the MXC sandbox, does its skill trigger?
evals.expected_output: Adds --ro for the plugin dir, passes --plugin-dir and a disableAllHooks settings file, uses a trigger-phrase prompt with stream-json to inspect skill/tool use, and notes hooks cannot run in BaseContainer

evals.prompt: I want to point claude at a repo I downloaded and don't trust. run it in MXC so it can't touch my claude config or credentials
evals.expected_output: Uses --isolated (not shared mode), explains auth needs a host CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set by the user, suggests --allowedTools limits, and does not grant drive roots or ~/.claude

evals.prompt: run claude mcp list inside MXC with node-based MCP servers working
evals.expected_output: Runs `mxc.ps1 run --allow-win32k ... -- mcp list`, explains --allow-win32k makes all folder names listable while contents stay denied, and warns uv-run servers still cannot start

evals.prompt: prove that claude inside MXC can't reach the network
evals.expected_output: Runs with --deny-net plus a short --timeout (claude retries the API until timeout, exit 124), optionally a cmd.exe/curl workload via MXC_CLAUDE_EXE, and reports that egress is blocked

evals.prompt: run my test suite inside a docker container
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger mxc-run: Docker/Podman container work, not Microsoft MXC
